mutants.name: M1-drop-walk-signal-guard
mutants.why: C-1 fix: plain Walk N: lines with no lens data must escalate, not return vacuous CONTINUE (thread 52). Removing the guard allows the defect to silently pass.

mutants.name: M2-drop-negation-stripping
mutants.why: Thread 58: NOT CLOSED must be stripped before searching for claim tokens so that 'NOT CLOSED' does not match as a positive claim. Removing stripping causes NOT CLOSED plans to escalate as claimed-close-unmet. The earlier selector (test_58_not_closed_returns_continue) was non-discriminating because its closing text contains no claim token even unstripped; the discriminating form is 'has not met the bar', where negation-stripping of 'not' turns 'not met' into ' met', matching _CLAIM_RE only in the mutant.

mutants.name: M3-drop-oserror-guard
mutants.why: C-2 fix: oversized path component from commentary text in the walk register line triggers OSError ENAMETOOLONG on macOS (thread 52). Removing the guard crashes the checker. The earlier selector (test_c2_long_component_no_traceback) was non-discriminating because its commentary tail is stripped before exists() runs; the discriminating form backticks the oversized component directly in the reference so it reaches the git_root/ref probe.
mutants.anchor: except OSError:  # C-2: oversized path component (thread 52)
mutants.replacement: except ValueError:  # C-2: oversized path component (thread 52)

mutants.name: M4-accept-unresolved-as-ok
mutants.why: C-3 fix: refs that resolve under neither git_root nor governance_root are UNRESOLVED and must escalate (thread 52). Accepting UNRESOLVED as ok allows a missing register to silently pass.
mutants.anchor: if a2_reg in ("FAIL", "UNRESOLVED"):  # C-3: UNRESOLVED routes same as FAIL (thread 52)
